subject: Invoice path and AP consent — email copies vs portal tokenization
messages:

Cc: AP Team <ap@celestis.ai>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice path and AP consent — email copies vs portal tokenization

Hi Marta —

Following yesterday's onboarding call, a quick follow-up on how Celestis wants to receive invoices once we go live:

Options we support today:
- Portal primary: e-invoice posted to your portal (token-based auth) + optional email copy to AP inbox
- Email primary: PDF invoice emailed to an AP address (or SFTP / webhook alternatives)

A couple of constraints we heard on the call: Celestis requires a single point-of-truth for invoice acceptance (your AP system) and cannot accept unsigned PDFs without a matching token. If the portal route is preferred we can generate a per-invoice token that your AP can use to automatically pull the invoice — eliminates manual downloads and reduces reconciliation mismatches.

Can you confirm: 1) whether Celestis will accept portal-tokened invoice pulls, and 2) if you still want a PDF email copy to ap@celestis.ai for internal receipts/archiving?

I'm attaching a sample invoice and a short portal onboarding checklist so your AP team can validate the token pull flow. If helpful, Connor can run a short test tomorrow to push a staged invoice.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@celestis.ai>

Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 11:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Invoice path and AP consent — email copies vs portal tokenization

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the clear summary. Short answers:
1) We prefer portal tokenization as the canonical source. Our AP system (KitePay) can do token pulls but the token must be included as a POST header and mapped to the invoice_number field.
2) We would like an email copy sent only when the invoice is greater than €5,000 or when the invoice is flagged as 'manual approval' in your system. Otherwise please do not send automatic email copies (we get duplicate ingestion).

A couple of requirements from our side:
- Token lifetime should be at least 7 days to allow for weekend processing.
- PDF filenames should include the invoice_number and tax_id (for our archive ingestion).

Connor, if you can share a sample POST header and a one-off test invoice (staging), we will route it to KitePay for a dry-run.

Best,
Marta
Finance Operations Manager, Celestis AI
Marta.Ruiz@celestis.ai

Hi Marta —

Thanks — I can run the dry-run. Technical notes and proposed tradeoffs below so Celestis can validate with KitePay:

1) Token mechanics (what we'd generate):
- Header: X-Redwood-Inv-Token: <TOKEN>
- Token payload includes invoice_number, issuer_tax_id, expiration_ts (epoch)
- Token lifespan: configurable per-customer (we can set to 7 days by default)

2) Delivery rules implemented server-side:
- If invoice_total > 5000 EUR OR invoice.manual_approval == true => send PDF email copy to configured AP email (ap@celestis.ai) + post to portal
- Else => post to portal only (no email)

3) Fallback: if portal post fails after 3 retries, we will email a signed PDF to a secondary AP inbox and create a ticket in the Redwood Console for follow-up.

Sample test request I will push to your staging endpoint:
POST https://staging.celestis.kitepay/invoices/pull
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer staging-key-abc
  X-Redwood-Inv-Token: {token}
Body: invoice payload (invoice_number, amounts, tax_id, pdf_url)

I attached a quick example token header and sample invoice (staging). Marta — can your team confirm a staging endpoint and an engineer contact? I'll queue the dry-run for Thu morning (your time).

Cheers,
Connor Obrien
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick responses and clear requirements. Confirming next steps from Redwood finance/billing ops: 

1) We'll enable token-based portal delivery for Celestis with token TTL set to 7 days.
2) Delivery rule: email copy only for invoices > €5,000 or flagged manual_approval.
3) Filename pattern for PDF: invoice_{invoice_number}_{issuer_tax_id}.pdf — we'll ensure that in the outgoing attachments.
4) Connor: please schedule the staging push for Thu 8:30 CET and include a sample token header in the request.

I'll generate a short SOW addendum to the onboarding checklist that codifies these rules and includes a one-click toggle in the console for Celestis to change the email-copy threshold if they want. Draft will be in Google Drive at the link below for review.
